## Verdict
accepted

## Concerns
- claim-1 and claim-2 are supported by the cited source excerpts.
- claim-3 is correctly conditional. The ratio calculation and induction prove
  \[
  \binom{2m}{m}\ge \frac{4^m}{2\sqrt m}
  =\frac{2^{n/2}}{\sqrt n}.
  \]
- The new target is established only assuming the minimality conjecture; no unconditional lower bound is established. The unspecified \(s,t\) are appropriately not treated as arbitrary.
